newsitem.title: UK: London Hong Kong stocks firm after rate decision.
newsitem.headline: London Hong Kong stocks firm after rate decision.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks rose in London trading as investors took heart from the U.S. Federal Reserve's decision on Tuesday to leave U.S. interest rates unchanged, dealers said.
"We're looking a bit better across the board in London, following on from Hong Kong. The rise in the UK market helped and people are expecting a boost from Wall Street this afternoon," said one.
Features were thin on ground but HSBC Holdings was up, rebounding from Tuesday's weakness.
By 1329 GMT, the Hong Kong London Reference index was 55.14 points higher at 11,658.67.

Overnight, Hong Kong shares ended higher after a see-saw day as investors took the opportunity to re-position portfolios after the U.S. Federal Reserve eased interest rate uncertainty with Tuesday's decision to hold rates steady.
The Hang Seng index finished 56.83 points higher at 11,603.53.
